title: Spread Service State
description: Sends each item of an array on by itself — one value in, as many out as it has items. (Runtimes: browser, node, python; IDs: spread)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

itemsFrom.description: Dotted path to the array in the input; the input itself by default

lastTotal.description: Read-only: how many items the last array had
